annotations.text: Every CF-sector air ball with him in centre

subtitle.text:
XO-2 proxy: 449 air balls ≥150 ft within 15° of dead centre with him in CF, each scored by the out share of similar balls (EV ±3, LA ±2, distance ±10
ft, direction ±10°) in 15,240 house comparisons. 261 outs vs 270.8 expected = -9.8, 6th of 9 Phillies CF seasons since 2015. Every neighbourhood
variant is negative (-2.9 to -9.8). External: −8 OAA, −2 DRS (CI-2). No catch probability in the log; read the rank and the sign, not the decimal.

title.text: Centre field: about 10 outs short of what the ball flight said, and the notebook's method could not see it
